titulo_original: You get one (The Plot in You)

sinopsis.es: Tras esnifar las cenizas de su padre muerto, un hombre que ha arrebatado la inocencia de muchos es confrontado por el espíritu de la adolescencia.
sinopsis.en: After snorting the ashes of his dead father, a man who has robbed many of their innocence is confronted by the spirit of adolescence.
